CHAPTER.VERS: Oh come, let us sing to Yahweh; Let us make a joyful noise to the rock of our salvation.
Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving; Let us make a joyful noise to him with psalms.
For Yahweh is a great God, And a great King above all gods.
In his hand are the deep places of the earth; The heights of the mountains are his also.
The sea is his, and he made it; And his hands formed the dry land.
Oh come, let us worship and bow down; Let us kneel before Yahweh our Maker:
Forty years long I was grieved with [that] generation, And said, It is a people who errs in their heart, And they have not known my ways:
Therefore I swore in my wrath, That they should not enter into my rest.
